name: Namrah Rashid
tagline: Real estate & brand content — scripted, filmed and edited by me.
about: Dubai-based content creator and multimedia specialist working across real estate and lifestyle brands. I handle the full process myself — scripting, filming, editing and publishing short-form video, plus design and photography. Comfortable both behind the camera and on it, with a strong eye for what actually performs on Instagram, TikTok and YouTube.

experience.role: Social Media Executive / Content Specialist / Video Editor
points: Plan, shoot, script and edit short-form real estate videos (AI-assisted + traditional) for Reels, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.
Run the brand's social accounts end-to-end — calendar, publishing, community engagement and market-update videos that drive enquiries.
Track performance and optimise campaigns for reach, engagement and lead conversion.
Created on-brand social content and oversaw all stages of podcast production.
Edited, colour-graded and subtitled videos for Instagram feed and Stories.
Built cross-platform content strategy and managed day-to-day account operations.

experience.role: Project Manager / Pre & Post Production Manager
points: Led pre- and post-production for real estate and brand shoots — crew, schedules and deliverables.
Captured high-quality property photography and video highlighting key listing features.
Partnered with the real estate team to produce visuals supporting sales and marketing.
Edit and refine footage into polished, high-retention content for a range of Dubai brands.
Develop social posts and creative concepts aligned to each brand's voice.
Presented and hosted on-camera, engaging audiences across segments.
Developed story ideas and handled scheduling and on-set coordination.
Collaborated with editors and producers to deliver to the creative vision.
